task.title: Manage destructive actions safely
task.shortdesc: Cancel or confirm archive, restore, reset, remove, and permanent-delete actions deliberately.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Destructive actions can hide a profile, remove settings, reset values, or permanently delete a row after confirmation.

step.cmd: Read the action label and affected profile or setting before confirming.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Cancel if the visible profile, lifecycle state, schema channel, or source attribution does not match the intended target.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: For permanent delete, confirm that export, comparison, and review are no longer needed.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: After confirmation, wait for the status message and refresh the Library or editor once before repeating the action.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: The action is either canceled safely or completed with a visible status and understood impact.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
